text:
mira: Heads-up 8 Arcadia Labs (midmarket) flagged they're likely to move to pay-as-you-go at renewal. Pain points: unexpected invoice spike, integration retries, and lack of enablement for their devs. Renewal ~18 days out. Need a focused save.

sam: Oof. Can finance pull a usage/billing breakdown and surface token vs embedding vs retry volume?

evelyn: On it. Initial glance shows a big spike on day 12. Suspect retry storms from their worker queue. Also they aren=t enabled batching we recommended.

tony: I can do a 60-min dev pairing to walk their engs through batching + backoff. Available tomorrow 11am ET.

mira: Proposed micro-play:
- Finance one-off billing investigation + goodwill credit if spike maps to our docs/guidance gap (evelyn/finance)
- 60m dev pairing to fix retries + enable batching (tony)
- 2-week enablement bundle (3x 30m check-ins)
- Conditional 20% credit on next invoice if they sign a 12-week enablement pact
- Structured feedback capture to feed product docs

sam: Keep credit language one-off and time-limited. Tagging @cs-bot to open billing investigation.

cs-bot: Created ticket CS-#4981: "Arcadia Labs  billing spike investigation" assigned to finance-ops. SLA 24h.

evelyn: Billing extract uploaded to CS-#4981: 3x spike on day 12, correlated with repeated failed calls from a worker. Attaching sample request IDs now.

tony: I'll prep a tiny demo repo showing correct batching + exponential backoff. Example snippet I'll share on the call:
```
// pseudo
const client = new Redwood({ key: process.env.KEY });
await client.generate({ batch: true, retry: { max: 3, backoffMs: 500 } });
```

mira: Draft outreach to customer:
```
Hi Jordan,
Thanks for raising this. We dug into your account and see retry storms that explain the spike. Proposed immediate steps: 1) a free 60-minute dev pairing to address retries + batching; 2) a billing review and potential one-time credit if the spike ties to retries; 3) enrollment in a short enablement track with weekly check-ins.
Can we book the pairing tomorrow at 11am ET?
Best, Mira (CSM)
```

evelyn: Ask them to share two failing request IDs to speed correlation.

tony: Confirmed for 11am ET. I'll bring the demo repo and a step-by-step checklist.

mira: Sent note. Also added a structured feedback link for product: https://internal.redwood/feedback/arcadia-quick

cs-bot: Note added to account Arcadia Labs  playbook "billing-rapid-inspect" applied.

mira: Customer replied: "11am ET works. We'll bring two request IDs. We're worried about costs but open to pairing."

sam: Finance-ops: if spike maps to client-side retries, approve a goodwill one-time credit and mark this play as high-priority. Keep me posted.

evelyn: Logs attached to CS-#4981 show misconfigured worker backoff causing repeated retries.

tony: Pairing completed. Fixed batching + backoff, validated in their staging environment, reduced retries to near-zero. Shared post-call checklist and repo link in the ticket.

mira: Immediate outcome estimate: projected monthly cost down ~42% after fixes. Customer asked for a short-term reduced commitment while they stabilize.

sam: Offer: 12-week enablement commitment + 20% one-time credit on next invoice. If they stabilize early we transition to normal renewal. Make terms explicit in the deal email.

evelyn: Filing product ticket PROD-#742 for adding clear batching/backoff examples to Node/Python SDK docs.

mira: I'll close loop with the customer, capture their acceptance, and update the account. Quick retrospective: root cause = enablement gap + missing docs example. Recommend a small docs push and an enablement playbook for similar accounts.

sam: Agreed. Fast technical fixes + transparent billing moves are low-effort, high impact on churn. Nice work team. :rocket:
